crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:e0.description: Come join our team at DIS-TRAN Steel! Our people – not our machinery - are our biggest assets. Our Mission is to provide paid, hands-on training that equips individuals with practical trade skills and life management tools, preparing them for successful careers and personal growth. DIS-TRAN Steel is looking for Fabrication Trainees to join the team at the Alexandria DIS-TRAN Steel Training Facility. The Fabrication Trainee will undergo training to become a skilled Fitter/Welder under the guidance of a DIS-TRAN Steel Vocational Training Instructor. The trainee will use machinery, welding torches, and hand tools to perform these tasks. This position will use other moving machinery or equipment in order to manipulate structures.

Examines work pieces to be processed to ensure that specifications are met.
Moves parts safely into position, manually or with hoists or cranes.
Welds components in flat positions.
Operates semi-automatic welding equipment to fuse metal parts.
Cleans welds with grinders and other equipment common to the welding trade.
Examines work pieces for defects and measures with weld gauges to ensure conformance with specification standard operating procedures.
qualifications: Must be at least 18 years of age.
High School Diploma or equivalent preferred.

pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:1affe023-3da8-4ad.title: Senior DevOps Engineer - Pay-i
pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:1affe023-3da8-4ad.description: About Pay-i At Pay-i, we are solving one of enterprise AI's most critical challenges: proving ROI of GenAI investments. While global GenAI spend races toward $600B by 2028, 72% of CIOs cite measurement and forecasting as their top blocker, and only 13% of business leaders report significant enterprise-level value from GenAI. We are the only platform that transforms every model call, prompt, and agent step into CFO-grade metrics, providing enterprises the financial transparency to identify winning use cases, optimize costs, and prove impact. Founded by ex-Microsoft leaders with 20+ years of experience each, Pay-i is a seed-stage company backed by five venture capital firms and executive/C-suite angels from Microsoft, Twilio, Zoom, and more. If you are passionate about selling products that fundamentally change how enterprises scale their AI initiatives, join us in bringing the system of record for GenAI ROI to market. The Opportunity As a DevOps Engineer, you will be a key member of our growing DevOps team, responsible for the design, deployment, and updating of our cloud infrastructure across multiple clouds. You will work closely with the development team on design and features. This role is crucial to our expansion as we broaden our product's reach to all three major clouds and on-premises solutions. What You'll Do Your impact will span across our entire infrastructure, including: - Creating and managing infrastructure deployments on AWS, Azure, GCP, and on-premises. - Supporting and validating deployments to ensure they are robust, reliable, and maintaining high availability and uptime. - Working closely with the development team to define infrastructure requirements. - Automating and supporting the deployment into various cloud and on-premise environments - As a part of the development team, monitoring active deployments and participating in live site activities - Contributing code as necessary, with opportunities for career growth in this area if desired. What You Bring Required Qualifications - 7 years of experience in a Senior DevOps or related role. - Strong proficiency with Terraform, ARM/Bicep, and Cloud Formation. - Proficient with Azure DevOps, Azure Pipelines, git, and bash. - Demonstrated success in fast-paced "bring up/tear down" environments. - Self-directed with strong technical opinions. - Comfort with ambiguity, experimentation, and rapid iteration. - Experience deploying and managing Kubernetes clusters and familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure. Preferred Qualifications - 10 years of experience in a Senior DevOps or related role. - Experience with Azure and AWS Marketplaces - Experience interacting with and supporting customers. - Developer experience is a bonus. What We Offer - Comprehensive health insurance. - Discretionary time off. - Opportunity to grow with the company. - Fast-paced, execution-focused environment with clear goals. - Collaboration with and mentoring from an extremely experienced founding team. Location - Based in Bellevue, WA. - Local, in-office presence required. - Occasional hybrid arrangements possible Why Pay-i? You'll join an extremely experienced team with clear goals and strong industry connections. We're well-funded, well-connected, and set up for success – now we need the right people to execute on our vision. As one of our early technical hires, you'll have the opportunity to shape our engineering culture and grow with the company. Pay-i is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

southparkcommons-preference-models:ashby.title: Member of Technical Staff - Machine Learning Capabilities
southparkcommons-preference-models:ashby.description: ABOUT US Preference Model is building automated ML research engineering. Existing frontier models are brittle when applied to real-world ML tasks. The present bottleneck is the lack of high-quality RL training environments. Our first step is to build RL environments that reflect real-world complexity, with diverse tasks and robust reward functions. Our founding team has previous experience on Anthropic’s data team building data infrastructure, and datasets behind Claude. We are partnering with leading AI labs to push AI closer to achieving its transformative potential. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re hiring experienced Machine Learning Engineers to design and build reinforcement learning environments to safely advance model capabilities in machine learning research and engineering. Specifically, you'll be teaching frontier models to do the work of an ML engineer or researcher at a frontier lab. This role blends research and engineering. It will require you to stay up to date with the latest research, develop novel approaches, and realize them in code. You will have full ownership and autonomy of the environments you build. Your work will include designing and implementing RL environments, conducting experiments and evaluations, delivering your work into production training runs, and collaborating with other researchers and engineers. You will join our Capabilities org, a small, high-ownership team and contribute directly to the data layer that powers frontier LLM capability. Note: This role is only for experienced ML Engineers. We have a separate opening for New Grads https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Preference%20Model/44642065-e592-44ba-810d-a019703463b6. WHAT YOU WILL DO: - Design and build RL environments and reward functions that produce clean, learnable signals for frontier models on ML research and engineering tasks - Build deep expertise across the frontier of ML research, training, and inference infrastructure - Collaborate with others to brainstorm and create new ideas and tools to improve the environment building process WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR (QUALIFICATIONS): - 5+ years of experience working in machine learning or research, primarily on LLMs and transformer models - You have strong ML fundamentals and broad research interests. You read many papers or tutorials, understand topics deeply and have the creativity to translate them into RLVR problems - Proficiency in Python and systems programming and at least one of PyTorch or JAX - Problem solvers who take ownership and drives solutions end-to-end - Passion for staying current with the rapidly evolving ML infrastructure landscape - Ability to meet throughput expectations and respond quickly to feedback YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU ALSO: - Have expert knowledge in an active DL/ML research area, with publications or public code to show for it. Research experience (PhD, MS) is a big plus - Have deep understanding of transformer internals, training/inference of modern LLMs, experience with inference libraries (vLLM, SGLang, etc) - Have strong expertise in kernel development (CUDA, Triton, Pallas) - Have built complex interactive RL environments WHAT WE OFFER: - Competitive cash and equity compensation (>90th percentile) - Ownership and autonomy in a fast moving startup environment - Opportunity to work with top machine learning engineers - Health, vision, dental, benefits - 401K match - Lunch provided everyday onsite - Weekly snack orders - Visa sponsorship & relocation support available We value diverse perspectives and experiences. If you're excited about this role but don't check every box, we still encourage you to apply.
